label: Canadian brokerage account (ACB)
Kanada 2026: en pool identiska börsnoter: Canada 2026: one pool of identical listed shares using average adjusted cost base (ACB). All identical shares for the same person must be included; separate brokers do not create separate cost bases. Realized capital losses may only offset capital gains and may be carried forward. Only disposals without superficial-loss conditions are supported; no automatic repurchase. Dividend class distinguishes foreign dividends from eligible/non-eligible Canadian dividends.
